count_interpretation: P0, P1, and P2 counts include propagation and document metadata boundaries; they are not all integrated-body semantic defects. The repaired PKG-12 function is clean after semantic and ABI re-review.

findings.title: Exact-key behavior contradicts lower-bound propagation
findings.finding: Live assembly performs lower-bound traversal, then rejects a greater successor in a final exact-key comparison and otherwise returns the end sentinel.
current_evidence: Live Ghidra disassembly and decompilation at 0x00e5c780
findings.boundary: Do not propagate lower-bound successor behavior to noun, star, cache, or other consumers until the contradiction is adjudicated.

findings.title: Alternate and canonical noun roots remain distinct
findings.finding: The audited alternate noun-root accessor is mechanically clean, but the canonical sibling at 0x00b3d400 reads a different slot; publication, equality, and lifetime are unresolved.

findings.title: Alternate and canonical star roots remain distinct
findings.finding: The audited alternate star-root accessor is mechanically clean, but the canonical sibling at 0x00b3d3a0 reads a different slot; publication, equality, and lifetime are unresolved.

findings.title: Interior SDK aliases are not independent function entries
findings.finding: Nine verified SDK labels are interior aliases of containing live functions and must not be promoted to separate entries.

findings.title: Observed cSPUITextZoom ABI overrides the interior SDK alias
findings.finding: The live 0x00834fa0 body has seven stack arguments and RET 0x1c; the six-parameter SDK label at 0x00835080 is interior and is not the canonical ABI.

findings.title: EditorNamePanel vtable projection is incomplete
findings.finding: The live table at 0x013f7b54 has observed targets at +0x30 and +0x58; the imported 0x20-byte projection does not establish exact inherited slot ownership.

findings.title: Palette setter name must remain bounded
findings.finding: 0x005cb240 is the live active-category setter; the interior stale GetSelectedRigblockPaint alias at 0x005cb2a0 is not evidence for its name.

findings.title: Persistence candidate is not a persistence manager
findings.finding: 0x00b28ec0 remains a path/header/stream/replacement persistence candidate; 0x00b3d440 is an accessor and does not establish manager membership or ownership.

findings.title: Local timeline command-line accessor is not Cell state
findings.finding: 0x00ff3f00 is a local timeline-event command-line pointer accessor on OpaqueTimelineEventData; its +0x8c field has no Cell-owner or online-network classification.

findings.title: Blocked dispatch remains local and has no network evidence
findings.finding: The blocked 0x00dd0e10 record remains a local timeline-event variant boundary; no target edge supports promoting it to online Sporepedia, Pollinator, or network semantics.

findings.title: Simulator_GetUIMissionLogManager alias is unresolved
findings.finding: The function body is mechanically clean, but Simulator_GetUIMissionLogManager is alias-unresolved and is not evidence of cMissionManager.
